lines.text: Many learners say: I am in the home.
At! She is at home now.

native.tip: “在家”的固定说法是 “at home”，不用 in the home。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I am in the home.”？😅 “在家”要说 at home，不加 the：“I am at home.”。跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“at home”。at home 是固定说法！免费测验在这里：{link}
